checks.rationale: AC1/AC2 are incomplete: required spec content may be malformed or omitted, and all ISO checks may be waived by untrusted N/A output. Deterministic graph/task/digest/scope and exact-runtime-result controls otherwise work.

The implementation respects the local deterministic scope, excludes TASK-016 and canonical approval writes, but incomplete specification context and unchecked applicability violate required current specification and isolation evidence.

Traced the complete service path and accepted graph/scope/agent interfaces. Actual-adapter probes reproduce false passing proposals for malformed/wrong-kind spec, absent spec.document_ref and all-N/A checks.

Typed input/provider errors produce non-passing decisions; bounded polling retains retryability and evidence, while unknown/cancelled mapping does not invent approval or release a lease. Actual adapter permission/model errors reject. Exact retry reuses one effect. No service-owned process, file, lease, or canonical state is created to clean up.

Stale digests, material task/context mutation, unordered collisions, wrong graph/checklist/model identity, and missing evidence are handled. Required structured context and applicability boundary cases remain defective.

Independent declared leaf passes 14 tests with nonzero count and exact candidate imports. Tests exercise meaningful negatives but use a wrong-kind spec stub for the passing fixture and omit malformed-spec, spec-document-closure and N/A-waiver regressions. The actual adapter positive/rewrite/negative probes confirm these are reachable.

One flat module, one owned test leaf and the existing implementation handoff. No unaccepted TASK-016 import, provider integration, new public wire schema, canonical approval mutation, source registry, or scope expansion.

Reconstructed raw binary diff and name/status list contain exactly the three owned added paths; no renames, deletions, unrelated metadata or dependency edits. Source/test/handoff blobs equal the owner-tested head after metadata merge.

The service implements IsolationService.review(IsolationRequest)->IsolationDecision using accepted immutable DTOs, ContractRegistry, graph builder, scope detector, and AgentAdapter. Decomposed validation helpers and injected content access retain explicit ownership; no parallel public contract.

Observed runtime model/request/handle/artifact binding is checked and actual adapter model forgery is rejected, but hashing arbitrary required spec bytes and trusting unapproved N/A claims lets untrusted material bypass the review gate.

The handoff accurately describes scope, signatures, deterministic-only provenance and coordinator authority, but its claims that malformed/missing required material never passes and every applicable check is evidenced are contradicted by the reproduced paths. Correct those claims alongside source and tracked regressions.

findings.description: src/isolation.py:393-399,476-495,566-590 treats required spec/other referenced JSON as opaque hashed bytes, validates only plan/graph/task, and collects only first-level plan/task references. A malformed spec ('{BROKEN JSON'), wrong-kind spec, or a valid spec whose document_ref is absent from explicit context reaches actual accepted AgentAdapter start/poll and returns succeeded/pass with a proposed graph. In the missing-document case the reviewer cannot read the specification document because it is absent from AgentRequest.scope.read_paths. This bypasses complete required context and can gate a graph against missing requirements. The passing owned fixture already uses {"kind":"fixture-spec"}.
findings.expected_fix: Validate required structured references with the accepted registry and expected record kind; derive and require their relevant explicit document/ADR/research/contract reference closure from verified supplied records, rejecting missing or malformed required material before dispatch. Preserve bounded context and existing ports without importing TASK-016. Replace the wrong-kind happy-path fixture with valid records, add tracked malformed/wrong-kind/missing-document regression controls through accepted modules, and align the existing handoff.

findings.description: src/isolation.py:943-955,977-988 accepts any not_applicable check with a nonempty rationale and never checks whether the waiver is permitted or the check is applicable. With all ISO-01..ISO-12 set to not_applicable, rationale 'No check is applicable', and empty evidence, an actual accepted adapter returns succeeded/pass and the service proposes the graph, although size, scope, sequencing and coverage apply to the two-task graph. _validate_existing_approval at 528-564 has the same missing applicability gate. Required checklist evidence can therefore be waived solely by untrusted output.
findings.expected_fix: Enforce applicability/allowed N/A decisions from trusted request material or explicit policy and require evidenced pass for every applicable ISO check, including prior approval validation. Fail closed when an N/A exemption is not established; do not treat a rationale alone as authorization. Add tracked all-N/A and individually applicable-check-waiver negatives plus a justified permitted-N/A control if supported, and update the existing handoff without changing frozen schemas.
